issues.summary: Engine never assigned lookup-reference column category, so payload columns of identified lookup tables landed as generic-non-sensitive.
issues.fixSummary: Added post-pass in HeuristicsEngine.Run that promotes non-key, non-system, non-PII, non-memo payload columns of lookup tables to ColumnCategory.LookupReference. R2 refined the guard from a positive allowlist to a negative exclusion list so format-pattern-recognised payload columns also promote.

issues.summary: DAO COM cleanup was incomplete — currentDb, tableDefs, fields collections, and Properties RCWs were not released in finally blocks.
issues.fixSummary: Every acquired DAO RCW (currentDbObj, tableDefsObj, td, fieldsObj, fd, propsObj, propObj) is now released in a paired finally so exceptions cannot leave live RCWs behind.

issues.summary: Sampler built SQL from unescaped schema names and then swallowed execution failures as zero counts, silently corrupting classification results.
issues.fixSummary: Introduced EscapeIdentifier helper that rejects ], NUL, CR, LF; narrowed per-query catches to surface ClassificationDegradation entries. R2 moved EscapeIdentifier inside the per-table/per-column try blocks so a rejected identifier becomes a degradation instead of aborting the scan.

issues.summary: TryRead*Property caught all exceptions, masking real DAO/COM property-read failures.
issues.fixSummary: Narrowed to catch (COMException). R2 further restricted with a when-clause that only treats DAO HRESULTs 0x800A0CC1 (item not in collection) and 0x800A0CB3 (operation not supported for this type) as 'property absent'; other COM failures bubble out as SchemaReadError degradations.

issues.summary: Implicit FKs exposing only a table name emitted fkTarget.column = '*' placeholder; the Degradations channel was unused despite the contract.
issues.fixSummary: Added ClassificationDegradation + IDegradationReporter; ResolveImplicitFk now refuses to fabricate a column name and emits UnresolvedImplicitFk for unresolvable RowSources; ClassifyCommand exits 3 and surfaces every degradation through --json-status. R2 tightened the composite-FK detector to only fire when FK_NAME is present, removing a false-positive fallback that conflated two parallel single-column FKs to the same target table.

issues.summary: Lookup post-pass only promoted columns already classified as generic, so format-pattern-recognised non-PII payload columns in lookup tables stayed sensitive-non-pii.
issues.fixSummary: Refactored the promotion guard from a positive allowlist (GenericNonSensitive | BusinessNaturalKey) to a negative exclusion list (PK / FK / memo / system-audit / both PII flavours / already-LookupReference). Pinned with Lookup_payload_promotion_includes_format_pattern_sensitive_columns test.

issues.summary: Rejected identifiers from EscapeIdentifier threw before the per-query degradation catches, aborting the classify run.
issues.fixSummary: Wrapped both EscapeIdentifier(table.Name) and EscapeIdentifier(col.Name) calls in their own try/catch blocks that convert ArgumentException into DegradationKind.SamplingError and continue.

issues.summary: TryRead*Property treated every COMException as 'property absent', potentially masking real DAO/COM property-read failures.
issues.fixSummary: Added DaoPropertyAbsentHResults set (0x800A0CC1 and 0x800A0CB3) and a when-clause filter so only those two HRESULTs are treated as 'property absent'; everything else bubbles out for the per-field SchemaReadError catch.

issues.summary: Composite-FK detection's fallback grouped by source-table → target-table pair when FK_NAME was missing, falsely conflating two parallel single-column FKs to the same target table.
issues.fixSummary: Removed the source→target fallback. Per-column FK targets are still always recorded; composite detection only fires when FK_NAME is populated and multiple rows share the same name.
